coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Counting 17 ground-truth variable items, 13 are matched (76%). The design covers consistent chronological splits, input and forecast lengths, cycle length, model types, input/output dimensions, epochs, batch size, normalization, cycle-index generation, MSE, MAE, and visualization outputs.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design replaces the specified RTX 4090 GPU with CPU-only computing, omits the RevIN on/off variable and synthetic-data generation parameters, and inconsistently specifies Adam versus AdamW rather than the required fixed Adam configuration. Batch sizes differ from the illustrative value of 256 but the batch-size variable is present.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion identifies a trained CycleNet capable of accurate forecasting or the accompanying visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
